newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Materials streamlines can business.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Materials streamlines can business.

text.p: Mitsubishi Materials Corp said on Monday it would streamline its aluminium can business to prevent it slipping into the red amid strong competition and higher aluminium prices.
The company said it would shift part of the production at its Fujikoyama plant to the more efficient Yuki and Gifu plants.
It also said it would raise its 1997/98 can output to 3.5 billion units, up 100 million from the previous year.
A company spokeswoman said a possible drop in can prices and the weaker yen led to the moves. She said the aluminium can business was currently posting profits, but did not give any figures.
Mitsubishi Materials is a leading Japanese manufacturer of aluminium cans.
